label: offer condolences
note: Chapter 272 closes this point narrowly with the attested contemporary sentence mama saṃvedanāḥ śokasantapta-parijanaiḥ saha santi, addressed to bereaved family members. The sentence is kept as one whole social formula and retrieved twice without a visible model. Earlier direct owners for grief, sorrow, death and compassion support its meaning, but the probe claims neither productive instrumental-plural grammar nor a wider condolence repertoire, social competence, human validation, learner attainment or exam readiness.
